ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with sparse, high-intensity (white) punctate pixels accounting for approximately 5-10% of total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white punctate blobs are dispersed across both lobes; concentration of high-intensity pixels observed along the median notch boundary and near the trailing edge serrations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an obtuse vertex angle estimated at 115 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; prominent jagged irregularities (peaks and valleys) with amplitudes varying between 3-10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep from the medial notch to the distal tips, characterized by a non-linear curvature on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive distribution of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring across the central and distal regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light on dark) visible primarily on the right lobe (viewer perspective).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jagged loss of tissue/contour on the distal margin of the left lobe (viewer perspective) relative to the right lobe symmetry.
